lesson.title: A fresh angle question
lesson.subtitle: P4 angle revision
lesson.objective: Measure an angle with a protractor.
lesson.story: Measure the angle with the protractor. What is its size in degrees?

steps.title: Measure the angle
steps.prompt: Measure the angle with the protractor. What is its size in degrees?
hints: Read where the second arm crosses the scale that starts at 0 on the base arm.
Long marks are every 10 degrees and short marks are every 5 degrees. Count along from 0.
The arm crosses just after 120, at the short mark halfway to the next long mark.

steps.title: Explain your thinking
steps.prompt: How did you decide which scale to read?

choices.label: I always read the outer scale, since it is the easier one to see.
I read the bigger of the two numbers where the arm crosses.
I read the scale that starts at 0 on the base arm of the angle.

hints: Think about where the angle starts.
The base arm lines up with one 0.
Always using the same scale gives the wrong answer for some angles.
Choose the explanation about the 0 on the base arm.
